title: Focus Active Window Engagement Input
description: When a window is active and has engagement, auto-focus the engagement input. Fix CAD play typing hitting all panes (global key capture + replIsQueryTypingTarget). Wire window activation to focus model definition.
summary: Window body pointer-down and printable keydown now focus and feed the engagement command input without a separate click. Added focusActiveEngagementInput, routeWindowEngagementKeydown, and shouldRouteKeysToWindowEngagement in ui. InteractionRepl with showAside=false routes global keys to the overlay engagement field instead of a hidden aside input.
